## Problem
Customers see error messages that falsely suggest a Keelwater system bug when the real issue is their own network failure. This creates unnecessary confusion and diverts attention from the actual root cause.

## Who is affected
- At least 2 accounts have reported this issue via support channels [i:12562525e3b8565d][i:64074f6fe85adcfb].
- One of the affected accounts, Marrowgate Commercial, has an ARR of £1,600,000 and is due for renewal on 2026-12-12 [i:12562525e3b8565d].
- The other affected account, Ormsgill Cyber, has an ARR of £135,000 [i:64074f6fe85adcfb].

## Evidence
- There have been 2 total mentions of this problem [i:12562525e3b8565d][i:64074f6fe85adcfb].
- All 2 mentions came through a single route: support [i:12562525e3b8565d][i:64074f6fe85adcfb].
- A user from Marrowgate Commercial stated, "I’ve ruled out our own systems — it’s definitely a customer network failure, not Keelwater being down, though the error message makes it sound like a bug." [i:12562525e3b8565d].
- A user from Ormsgill Cyber stated, "That’s what I suspected — our IT team is looking into the customer network failure now. Sorry for the false alarm." [i:64074f6fe85adcfb].
- The total ARR from accounts that have mentioned this issue is £1,735,000 [i:12562525e3b8565d][i:64074f6fe85adcfb].
- In the last 90 days, 1 of the affected accounts has renewed [i:12562525e3b8565d].

## Why now
This issue is actively causing confusion and wasted effort for at least two customers, as evidenced by their recent support interactions in September and October 2026 [i:12562525e3b8565d][i:64074f6fe85adcfb]. One of these customers, representing a significant portion of the affected ARR, is approaching a renewal date in December 2026, making the clarity of system communication a timely concern [i:12562525e3b8565d].
</previous_draft>
